description: Ask the developer's browser to find this element again, right now, and report what changed since they marked it — with a fresh crop next to the original one. Call it before editing anything marked a while ago, and whenever an annotation says it may be stale. A verdict of gone or moved means the selector in the annotation should not be trusted as-is.

id.description: Annotation id (8 chars) or its pin number

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the browser. Default 10

name: recheck_annotation
title: Re-check an annotation against the live page
